properties.description: PRODUCTION pipeline. Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'J990_Jen_Extraccion_IB' (JobType=0, sequential). Category: \Jobs\Fase_5\Hito_0\Param_and_Others\J990_Jen. Source: journal.dbo.jen via Sybase ODBC. Filter: jen_fec_evt_neg = dateadd(-7 days, FechaProceso) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)='IB'. Output: pipe-delimited flat file {PathTemp}{NombreJob}_JOURNAL_JEN_IBM.TXT.{FechaArchExtraccion}.

activities.name: ExecuteDataFlow_Trf_Jen
activities.description: Executes the Mapping Data Flow that replicates DataStage stages: CODBCStage(Sybase_Jen_IBM_7_Dias) -> CTransformerStage(Trf_Jen) -> CSeqFileStage(Seq_Jen). SQL filter applied at source.

query.value: SELECT jen_ope_evt, jen_fec_evt_neg, jen_fec_ctb_evt, jen_rut_cli, jen_vrf_cli, jen_rut_emp, jen_vrf_emp, jen_id_cnl, jen_est_cnl, jen_suc_ori, jen_med, jen_id_med, jen_tip_opr_bci, jen_id_opr, jen_mod_tar, jen_fra_lin, jen_ara_cua, jen_id_svs, jen_est_evt_neg, jen_id_pdt, jen_id_evt, jen_id_sub_evt, jen_clv_ppl, jen_mto, jen_clv_sgd, jen_cpo_var FROM @{pipeline().parameters.DBO_Journal}.jen WHERE CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE) = DATEADD(day, -7, CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.FechaProceso}' AS DATE)) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt, 1, 2) = 'IB'

FechaProceso.description: Process date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Matches DataStage $FechaProceso. Used to compute extraction window: dateadd(day,-7, FechaProceso).

FechaArchExtraccion.description: File date suffix in YYYYMMDD format. Matches DataStage $FechaArchExtraccion. Used in output filename.

Sybase_Journal.description: Sybase DSN name. Matches DataStage $Sybase_Journal. Configure in ls_Sybase_Journal linked service.

Sybase_User.description: Sybase username. Matches DataStage $Sybase_User. Store in Key Vault.

Sybase_PWD.description: Sybase password. Matches DataStage $Sybase_PWD. Original was IIS-encrypted: {iisenc}wEKfQZUV7bMUWi7ix8v1Aw==. Store in Key Vault.

DBO_Journal.description: Schema/owner for journal tables. Matches DataStage $DBO_Journal. Used in table reference: {DBO_Journal}.jen

PathTemp.description: Output path/container. Matches DataStage $PathTemp. Maps to ADLS container or folder.

NombreJob.description: Job name used in output filename. Matches DataStage $NombreJob (local param, default: J990_Jen).

annotations: source_filter: jen_fec_evt_neg = dateadd(-7, FechaProceso) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)='IB'
